title: ENCHTABLE: Unified Safety Alignment Transfer in Fine-tuned Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's Unsafe Rate (ratio of unsafe responses to total queries) using the DangerousQA dataset, which contains adversarial prompts explicitly emphasizing racist attributes, assessed via an LLM-based safety judge.
Evaluating the model's Unsafe Rate using the DangerousQA dataset, which includes prompts designed to elicit sexist content, assessed via an LLM-based safety judge.
Measuring the model's propensity to generate unsafe or harmful responses to prompts targeting general social stereotypes, utilizing the DangerousQA dataset.
